title: Run FT-002 integrated verification and durable docs sync
verify: The full FT-002 migration/bootstrap/service/permission/API suite passes together and all three behavior specs have direct executable traceability.
An integrated Engineer flow proves create, immediate list/read/rename, and denial of lifecycle/access management; Consultant remains read/comment only.
An integrated Boss flow proves archive, grant mutation while archived, non-operative access, restore, stable grant identity, and current permission resolution.
Foundation health/readiness and all completed FT-001 auth/session/ActorContext regressions remain green.
PostgreSQL-only evidence and any environment gaps are reported truthfully; SQLite/test doubles are not represented as product authority evidence.
Feature, RTM, epic, changelog, and routing docs synchronize only the FT-002-owned result and leave FT-003/downstream/cross-feature REQ-007 portions open.
Feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-002 is recommended after all FT-002 tasks close because archive/authz semantic drift is material.
evidence_required: full regression test output including Foundation and FT-001
Engineer and Boss integrated flow evidence
constraints: Do not add new FT-002 product behavior during the integration/docs gate; route implementation gaps back to the owning task/spec.
Do not mark shared REQ-003/004/006/007 fully verified where later features still own acceptance.
Do not claim FT-003 admin/first-Boss, retained-history contents, downstream archive integration, UI, or PWA completion.
Record only reproducible redacted evidence and distinguish PostgreSQL runs from unavailable environment paths.
invariants: Foundation and completed FT-001 behavior remain regression constraints.
Archive is a global operational deny but FT-002 does not fabricate downstream records to claim their integration.
Memory Bank lifecycle and RTM statements must match task evidence exactly.
Secrets and auth material never enter evidence or durable docs.
verification_targets: Trace FT-002-BHV-001 through FT-002-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests and task evidence.
Check every FT-002 card remains schema-valid, indexed once, dependency-acyclic, and linked to the direct canonical subset.
Check durable docs report only FT-002-owned requirement evidence and explicit deferred cross-feature archive checks.
purpose: Provide one coherent integration and durable synchronization boundary for the completed FT-002 implementation queue.
success_outcome: FT-002 evidence is complete and internally consistent, completed Foundation/FT-001 behavior regresses cleanly, and durable docs are ready for feature-level semantic review.
anti_goals: No new feature implementation hidden inside the gate.
No FT-003 or downstream feature closure.
No overclaiming unavailable PostgreSQL or cross-feature evidence.

stop_conditions: Any FT-002 prerequisite task is not done or its evidence contradicts a canonical spec.
Focused integration exposes a missing behavior that requires widening an earlier task or public contract.
PostgreSQL authority claims cannot be distinguished from SQLite/test-double evidence.
Docs sync would overclaim shared requirement or downstream feature completion.
Evidence contains secrets or auth material.
